ShortDescription.Value: Fix Not Enough Customers icons by balancing commercial shop production and shopping demand.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛒 Too many "Not Enough Customers" icons?
**Adding more citizens doesn't always fix it!**
This mod helps struggling shops recover by **balancing production and shopping demand**. No fake shoppers, no complicated settings!
### Why does vanilla struggle?
- **90%+ unused Service** triggers NEC warnings. But vanilla's shopping-priority score stops distinguishing struggling shops once unused Service exceeds 50%. * Shop workers get paid to produce Service. Service is different from goods (e.g., food, paper...) you see delivered. * **Shops keep producing** even when they already have too much unsold Service. Vanilla doesn't clamp production to zero until the shop hits 100% full Service which is too late to prevent the NEC icons. - Citizens can't shop while at work or school. Only available adults and elderly can handle normal shopping, making rush hours especially difficult.
**Result: Too much Service, shoppers going to random shops that are not prioritized and don't need help!**
### How this mod helps
- ✅ **Acts early at 82%** unused Service, with stronger production cuts at 89% before the critical 90% threshold. - ✅ **Improves shopping demand** using your existing citizens, no fake shoppers. - ✅ Helps Retail and Leisure businesses (Meals, Entertainment, Recreation). - ✅ Helps **Hotels** attract existing tourists and reduce empty rooms. - ✅ Performance-friendly: automatically reduces unnecessary work when NEC warnings are low.
### Real test results 🎉
- **130k city:** 165 NEC → just **4** after ~30 minutes. - **90k city:** 335 NEC → **30** after 10 minutes, **7** after 20 minutes
### What to expect
* **Install and play!** No Options menu settings needed. * Some cities improve within 5 minutes. Allow **15–30 minutes** for more changes. * A few remaining warnings? Prune some if needed or check pathing to the buildings. * Safe to remove, Vanilla takes over again. No Harmony patch means more compatible with other mods and the game. * Companion [mod City Watchdog](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/144908/Windows) recommended to easily see totals go up/down like shown in the screenshot. Make sure to put a "blue star" next to Not Enough Customers. * This mod is a temp fix until IFS is able to fix/prioritize commercial businesses exploding in Not Enough Customers Icons.
**Tip:** A full commercial demand bar doesn't mean your citizens can support more shops! It means companies are looking for spaces.
### Support and Feedback
* Support by clicking the LIKE 👍 button (top right)! No donations, just a free like for the many days of work. * Feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-NoCustomersFix), GPL-3.0 license.
